comment: The first command of the game is a kick with a count of 6. cmd.c parse() leaves gm.multi at 5 and dokick() answers ECMD_TIME, so rhack() keeps the count and allmain.c moveloop_core() calls rhack(gc.cmd_key) again on each later turn; every repeat asks "In what direction?" afresh. The third kick hits a wall: dokick.c kick_ouch() calls losehp(), whose end_running(TRUE) zeroes gm.multi, so the last three repeats never run and the space that follows is an unknown command. The first ^A reports that no command is available to repeat, because the unknown command emptied CQ_REPEAT. No earlier command has run cmd.c reset_cmd_vars(), so svc.context.run still holds the zero C starts it with: hack.c lookaround(), which allmain.c moveloop_core() calls before each repeat, returns at `svc.context.run == 0` without examining the squares next to the hero. A square there would stop a run. The seed, date and character were chosen for this recipe.
